mechanism: On window N (power-of-2 preferred) of close or MACD/RSI series, DFT for k=1..N/2−1; amplitude=√(Re²+Im²); keep k_dom with max amplitude and phase=atan2(Im,Re); emit y_pred=sin(φ_dom+2π k_dom (N−1)/N) ∈[−1,1] as cycle trough/peak state for turning-point sensing.
data_needed: Rolling close/MACD/RSI array size InpFourierWindow; real/imag sums; dominant k and phase.

mechanism: Leaky Integrate-and-Fire: static V_buy/V_sell *= (1−InpSnnDecay) each bar; add weighted pre-synaptic inputs (Fourier cycle, RSI momentum Δ over 5 bars, MACD momentum Δ); fire buy/sell spike only if V≥InpSnnThreshold then reset V→0—requires multi-bar accumulation before execution.
data_needed: Fourier signal ∈[−1,1]; rsiValues[0]−rsiValues[4]; macdValues[0]−macdValues[4]; weights w1/w2/w3; decay and threshold inputs.
